findings.location: reports/current.md 第290行，For distributors 段首句："adding another outlet can diversify access while also duplicate acquisition spending on the same users"。
findings.basis: while also 后的 duplicate 未形成可承接的谓语结构，读者需要自行把句子还原为两个并列可能结果。按自然表达要求，改成 "can diversify access while also duplicating acquisition spending..."，或 "can both diversify access and duplicate acquisition spending..."；保留多渠道扩张同时可能重复获客的原意即可，无需扩展分析。
